{"command": "cd units
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, csv, io
# csvfix edge: quoting
sys.path.insert(0,'csvfix')
import impl as csvimpl
print("csvfix quoted:", csvimpl.parse('"a,b",2,x'))
print("csvfix 4col:", csvimpl.parse('a,b,c,d'))
print("csvfix bad amount raises:", end=" ")
try:
    csvimpl.total([["a","1","zz"]])
    print("NO")
except ValueError:
    print("ValueError")
# flags tricky
sys.path.insert(0,'flags'); sys.path.insert(0,'intervals'); sys.path.insert(0,'rules'); sys.path.insert(0,'schedule')
from flags import Impl as F
print("flags --k -5:", F().parse(["--k","-5"]))
print("flags --k=--v:", F().parse(["--k=--v"]))
print("flags dash:", F().parse(["a","-","b"]))
# intervals
from intervals import Impl as Ii
i=Ii()
print("intervals merge nested:", i.merge([[0,10],[2,3]]))
print("intervals subtract split:", i.subtract([[0,10]],(4,6)))
print("intervals total:", i.total_length([[0,2],[2,4]]))
# schedule equal-gap stays split
from schedule import slots, overlaps
print("schedule gap==minutes:", slots([(0,60),(30,90),(120,150)],30))
print("schedule touch overview:", overlaps((0,10),(10,20)))
# rules
import importlib
eng = importlib.import_module("engine")
print("rules empty all/any:", eng.evaluate({"all":[]},{}), eng.evaluate({"any":[]},{}))
PY"}
